mu_name_from: MODEL_DARK_RAVEN_ITEM, MODEL_HELPER+5: Item/spiritbill.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp), its sheets from Skill\: dksbody (the feathers) and dkshelmet (the helm plate). ITEM_DARK_RAVEN_ITEM, group 13 number 5, named "Dark Raven" (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Pets.cs:75). The bag icon and the drop; the flying bird is DarkRavenFly (docs/plans/dark-lord-pets/client.md section 1).
profile_note: A small held object seen in the bag, as the horn.
sheet_from: Data/Skill/dksbody.OZT (128x128, black feathers on an alpha that cuts the magenta away) and dkshelmet.OZJ (128x32, blue-steel plate with gold), from MuMain's own bin/Data, under a raven_ prefix as the Trainer's bird carries sheets of the same names.
sheet_materials_from: Judged from the sheets: black feathers, and the helm the horse's enamelled plate with gold trim.
cutout_from: dksbody.OZT's alpha cuts the feathers' edges.

stats.note: The item's own row, from OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser: the Dark Lord's (0.99+), not 0.75's. **After 0.75**, marked.
stats.call: this.CreatePet(5, 0, 1, 1, "Dark Raven", 0, false, false); ItemSlot 1 (the left hand); PetExperienceFormula; QualifiedCharacters AllLords; MaximumItemLevel 50
stats.requires_note: No level: it asks Command 185 + 15 a level to be worn and to act (WebZen zzzitem.cpp:506-524, sim::ravenCommand).
stats.power_note: Worn in the left hand, no shield beside it. Strikes on its own: 180 + 15L + Cmd/8 to 200 + 15L + Cmd/4 (WebZen DarkSpirit.cpp:640-689); docs/plans/dark-lord-pets/README.md.
stats.price_note: 1,000,000 a level, a third back (WebZen CItem::PetValue, sim::petValue). Bred at the Pet Trainer from a Spirit +1.
